title: Santorini: Caldera Honeymoon Escape
summary: A private, slow six nights above the caldera — a sunset catamaran, a table held just for two, and a cliffside suite in Oia's quieter northern edge.
highlights: A private sunset catamaran along the caldera
A private dinner table over the caldera
A cliffside suite with a private plunge pool
A family vineyard wine tasting for two

itinerary.description: Assyrtiko tasted where it's grown, then the Bronze Age ruins at Akrotiri.
